title: Harbor triangle rezoning including Maui Ocean Center
summary: A committee has moved to decision making on rezoning six properties in the triangle area by the harbor, and the resolution now goes to the full council. Unlike a 2022 proposal covering only the Maui Ocean Center properties, this one also includes the harbor shops, and the owners agreed to split costs half and half. Presenters said some current zoning labels do not exist in county code, and a testifier raised concerns about aquarium pathogens.
